final: WITH feature_totals AS (SELECT SUM(traitcount) as total_features, COUNT(DISTINCT zoneref) as num_sites FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), site_features AS (SELECT zoneref, SUM(traitcount) as feature_count FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zoneref), site_shares AS (SELECT s.zoneref, s.feature_count, CAST(s.feature_count AS REAL) / ft.total_features as share, (CAST(s.feature_count AS REAL) / ft.total_features) - (1.0 / ft.num_sites) as margin_above_avg FROM site_features s CROSS JOIN feature_totals ft) SELECT zoneref, feature_count, share, margin_above_avg FROM site_shares WHERE margin_above_avg > 0 ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10
